L: %0/%1: The current line shown in the editor toolbar, e.g. "L: 3/16". %0 is the number of the line with the cursor, %1 is the line limit.
L: %0: The current line shown in the editor toolbar when there is no line limit, e.g. "L: 3".
W: %0: The word count shown in the editor toolbar, e.g. "W: 19".
Char(s): %0: The number of characters in the line with the cursor, shown in the editor toolbar, e.g. "Char(s): 30".
Words: The tooltip of the word count in the editor toolbar.
Characters in the current line: The tooltip of the character count in the editor toolbar.
Current line: The tooltip of the current line number in the editor toolbar.
